note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown (imago unknown), hence only the soldier and worker sections; the measurement table (Table 6) is unusable because of disordered OCR rows, so the measurements are taken from the text; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, type specimen and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier body length about 6.00–6.20 mm, head capsule subquadrate with nearly straight sides, ratio of width to head length to mandibular base 0.520–0.628; labrum asymmetrical, without anterolateral points and without setae; postmentum long, club-shaped, narrowing gradually at the waist, waist width about half the maximum width.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to yellow, the fontanelle gland area semi-transparent; antennae slightly paler than the head capsule; labrum semi-transparent; left mandible blackish brown, right mandible reddish brown; legs and body pale yellow. Cephalic and body setae rather sparse. Body length about 6.00–6.20 mm. Head capsule subquadrate; sides nearly straight; wider than half the head length to the mandibular base (ratio of maximum width to head length 0.520–0.628); the median arm of the Y-suture not reaching half the head length; in lateral view the frons inclined anteriorly in the anterior quarter. Fontanelle transverse, situated where the frontal slope inclines; ratio of the occiput–fontanelle distance to head length 0.78; fontanelle gland rather large. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 about half of segment 1; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 as long as segment 2; segments 5–8 gradually longer, segments after the 9th gradually shorter. Labrum asymmetrical, semi-transparent, ligulate; without anterolateral points and without setae. Mandibles strongly asymmetrical. Left mandible strongly twisted, the apex rounded, strongly inflated at the middle (length 1.83–1.93 mm). Right mandible blade-like, the apex pointed (length 1.85–1.90 mm). Postmentum long, club-shaped; narrowing gradually posteriorly at the waist, waist width about half the maximum width. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe rounded, without a notch; mesonotum narrower, metanotum about as wide as the pronotum.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Monomorphic. Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, legs and thorax whitish; abdomen greyish white because of the intestinal contents showing through. Head sparsely hairy, body more densely so. Body length about 3.50–4.20 mm. Head capsule subcircular; widest at the mandibular bases, narrowing posteriorly (length to the tip of the labrum 1.30–1.38 mm, length to mandibular base 0.83–0.88 mm, maximum width 1.10–1.13 mm). Fontanelle plate semi-transparent, oval (length 0.08–0.10 mm, width 0.06–0.08 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segments 2 and 3 nearly equal, segment 4 slightly shorter. Postclypeus inflated, less than half as long as wide (length 0.20–0.23 mm, width 0.55 mm). Mandibles each with one apical tooth and two marginal teeth; apical tooth finger-like, longer than the 1st marginal tooth; the trace of the 2nd marginal tooth weak in the left mandible, without a notch between the two marginal teeth. Pronotum saddle-shaped; the middle of the anterior lobe without a notch (length 0.25 mm, width 0.55–0.58 mm).
